title: EStream: Fast and Memory-Efficient MoE Prefill through Expert Virtualization on Mobile NPUs
abstract: arXiv:2609.06551v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mobile vendors and application developers increasingly deploy LLMs on smartphones for diverse prefill-only services. Yet current systems rely mainly on dense models whose regular computation maps efficiently to mobile NPUs, leaving more capable MoEs underused. MoE prefill does not fit mobile NPUs: NPU graphs are fixed at compile time, yet MoE picks experts at runtime; and one request touches most experts, more than a phone can hold in memory. We present EStream, which resolves both by separating what the NPU must fix from what MoE decides at runtime. A single compiled expert graph serves every expert, with each expert's routed tokens and weight address bound at call time, so dynamic MoE execution runs entirely on the NPU without padding or CPU/GPU fallback. Expert virtualization keeps the expert pool in UFS flash storage and pages it through a fixed-size NPU-addressable arena, group by group, with loading hidden behind computation, so

translated_title: EStream：通过专家虚拟化在移动NPU上实现快速且内存高效的MoE预填充
translated_abstract: 移动设备厂商和应用开发者日益在智能手机上部署大语言模型（LLM），以提供多样化的仅预填充服务。然而，现有系统主要依赖稠密模型，因为其规整的计算能够高效映射到移动NPU上，这使得能力更强的MoE（混合专家）模型未得到充分利用。MoE预填充并不适配移动NPU：NPU计算图在编译时即已固定，而MoE却在运行时才选择专家；且单个请求会触及大多数专家，其数量超过了手机内存所能容纳的极限。我们提出了EStream，通过将NPU必须固定的内容与MoE在运行时决定的内容分离开来，同时解决这两个问题。单一编译的专家计算图可服务于所有专家，每个专家的路由令牌和权重地址在调用时绑定，因此动态MoE执行完全在NPU上运行，无需填充或CPU/GPU回退。专家虚拟化将专家池保存在UFS闪存中，并通过固定大小的NPU可寻址内存区域按组分页加载，加载过程隐藏于计算之后，从而……
tldr: EStream通过将NPU编译时固定的计算图与MoE运行时的动态专家选择解耦，并利用专家虚拟化技术将专家权重存储于闪存中按组分页、以计算隐藏加载延迟，实现了移动NPU上快速且内存高效的MoE预填充。
en_tdlr: EStream decouples the compile-time fixed NPU graph from MoE's runtime expert selection and employs expert virtualization to page experts group-by-group from flash storage with loading hidden behind computation, enabling fast and memory-efficient MoE prefill on mobile NPUs.
